name: benzocaine + camphor (natural) + phenol
purpose: Purpose Analgesic, Anesthetic, Antipuritic First Aid Antiseptic Topical Analgesic
uses: Uses First aid to help prevent infection in minor cuts, scrapes, and burns. For temporary relief of pain and itching associated with: insect bites minor burns minor cuts skin rashes due to poison ivy, poison oak, and poison sumac
otcwarn: Stop use and ask doctor if condition worsens, or symptoms persist for more than 7 days or clear up and occur again within a few days. Do not use longer than one week unless directed by a doctor.

src.label: OFF Bite and Itch Relief First Aid Antiseptic
